name: netconfig-agent
description: NetConfig Agent - Local network device manager that connects to the cloud web app

scripts.build: npm run bundle && pkg dist/bundle.cjs --targets node18-win-x64 --output dist/NetConfigAgent.exe --config pkg.json
scripts.build:all: npm run bundle && pkg dist/bundle.cjs --targets node18-win-x64,node18-linux-x64,node18-macos-x64 --output dist/NetConfigAgent --config pkg.json
